subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The national flag was hoisted by the minister.

options.text: The minister hoist the national flag.
The minister was hoisted the national flag.
The minister hoisted the national flag.
The minister will hoist the national flag.

solution:
The correct answer is 'The minister hoisted the national flag.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Past Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a sentence in Past Tense from Passive voice to Active voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e., the object of the passive sentence become the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The active voice starts with the object of the passive voice.
